gap_analysis.objective: Run one nine-day decentralized LLM supply-chain trajectory through a flood disruption and report production, service, cost, and recovery bottlenecks.

requirement.description: Four decision phases per day (manufacturer order, joint suppliers, logistics, manufacturer produce/settle) over nine days with per-phase actor sets

decisions.reason: sequential.v1's finite phase schedule with configured per-phase actor sets matches the required order/supply/ship/settle cadence exactly, including the joint supplier phase.

requirement.description: Live LLM actors with schema-constrained actions, contextual legality retries, and exact zero-action fallback

decisions.reason: llm.v1 supplies schema-constrained decisions with a retry budget but no domain legality precheck or configured fallback; the wrapper adds observation-only bound checks mirroring the mechanism plus an exhausted-attempt exact fallback, preserving the canonical observation packet and call records.

requirement.description: Multi-echelon inventory, one-day transit pipeline, flood capacity schedule, demand fulfillment, and settlement accounting with decentralized privacy

decisions.reason: No approved mechanism models component-pair assembly, shared flood-disrupted transport, asymmetric private information, or this settlement accounting; extend Mechanism.
No approved action schemas cover these four role-specific integer payloads; extend Pydantic models.

requirement.description: Typed world parameters plus seven explicit single-option modeling conventions with rejection of unsupported values

decisions.reason: Supplied economics and convention options need a dedicated validated parameter model; extend Pydantic model.

requirement.description: Action-independent mathematical reference for sales performance

decisions.reason: No approved solver fits this asymmetric-information sequential game, so a plain-function physical sales bound (710 units) serves as the mathematical reference instead of a Solver/GameView.

requirement.description: Explanatory preview and final notebooks with domain figures and recovery analysis

decisions.reason: Trusted preview/experiment notebook writers supply the five-section contract; domain calculations live in external helpers.
